integrity: Direct analytic proof of the full real-parameter theorem, supported by finite numerical cross-checks. No external reviewer certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed, exogenous two-phase scalar strict-coordination games only; monotonicity concerns the per-unit-time exponent and the uniquely selected interior periodic orbit, not the raw cycle multiplier. No stochastic or multidimensional extension proved; independent validation not performed.
title: Strict Floquet slowdown under slower periodic switching of coordination games
